source_note: 无理测度的定义以及基本的命题
callout_id: 无理测度的定义以及基本的命题#10
statement_en: Let $\alpha$ be an irrational number. A positive integer $q$ is a best approximation to $\alpha$ if and only if $q$ is the denominator of some convergent in the continued fraction expansion of $\alpha$.
key_techniques: characterization of best approximations by convergents
callout_body: 令$\alpha$是一个无理数，正整数$q$为$\alpha$的最佳逼近，当且仅当$q$是$\alpha$对应的的连分数展开的某个收敛分数（convergent）的分母。
